title: Mr. Ejoku Builds the Future
subtitle: Working Fathers of Soroti
author: Anthony Mwesigwa
description: Follow Mr. Ejoku, a construction foreman, as he leads his team to build Soroti's newest community center.
keywords: construction, foreman, building, Uganda, Soroti, family, work, father, engineering, scaffolding
dedication: For all who build the future with skill and dedication.
authorBio: Anthony Mwesigwa is a passionate storyteller from Kampala, Uganda, dedicated to creating engaging educational books for young African readers.
backCoverText: How do buildings get built? Join Mr. Ejoku, a construction foreman, as he leads his team, reads blueprints, and builds Soroti's new Community Center.
